text: ASML reported record quarterly bookings, expanded forward sales guidance, and initiated a multiyear share buyback while announcing a net workforce reduction, revealing simultaneous capital concentration, demand saturation at advanced nodes, and internal structural tightening within the semiconductor equipment layer.
